entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: Warlord who fought across the Domains of Dominaria and died at Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Mors Ridge
entities.description: Town where Ham kept Palladia-Mors at bay.

entities.name: Ham
entities.description: Boy who performed "Tickery" magic to keep Palladia-Mors at bay.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Elder Dragon awakened by canal digging at Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: Elder Dragon who posed as Red Donald's Dragon Whelp familiar.

entities.name: Balgot
entities.description: Orc general who killed Red Donald.

entities.name: Battle at Mors Ridge
entities.description: Battle started when Palladia-Mors was awakened.

events.summary: Red Donald, urged by his Dragon Whelp familiar, dug canals in the ridge, awakening Palladia-Mors and starting the Battle at Mors Ridge.
events.quote: This awoke Palladia-Mors, starting the Battle at Mors Ridge .

events.summary: The Dragon Whelp was revealed as Vaevictis Asmadi, who needed Palladia to lift the curse that turned him into a whelp.
events.quote: The Dragon Whelp was revealed to be Vaevictis Asmadi .

events.summary: The orc general Balgot killed Red Donald with a poisoned blade.
events.quote: The orc general Balgot killed Red Donald with a poisoned blade.
